021K.consumed_boundary: Current semantic state/compatibility/reconciliation standing is specialist-owned; UNKNOWN is distinct from NOT_APPLIED and current compatibility must be explicit.

021P.consumed_boundary: Current revoked, compromised, disallowed or UNKNOWN cryptographic/key standing fails closed for consequential use.

021R.consumed_boundary: Current exact-subject release eligibility is specialist-owned and includes UNKNOWN/INELIGIBLE/REVOKED/QUARANTINED-style non-eligible standings; F-WP-009 consumes normalized current standing only.

021Y.consumed_boundary: Provider qualification/current standing remains 021Y-owned; F-WP-009 consumes only a read-only current standing and maps unknown/stale/conflicting input to UNKNOWN/fail-closed.
021Y.explicit_residual: F-WP-009 does not implement or close parent 021Y and does not mutate provider governance truth.

normalization_rule: Specialist current standings are normalized only to ELIGIBLE, PROHIBITED or UNKNOWN plus schema/data COMPATIBLE, INCOMPATIBLE or UNKNOWN. Normalization never changes source authority or promotes unknown evidence.
boundary_rule: This gate authorizes the bounded 021F recovery coordinator adapter only; it does not implement 021K, 021P, 021R or 021Y services.
